name: Return to Thunder Bluff
summary: Apothecary Lydon’s toxin is bound for Thunder Bluff, where Zamah awaits it. She needs the formula to make a device that can spread it against the Venture Company.

sections.title: A Transcontinental Delivery
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon has made the toxin from the ingredients gathered in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He wants to see it tested on living subjects, but the liquid needs a way to spread it. You carry the vial across the Great Sea to Mulgore, where Apothecary Zamah waits for it.

sections.title: Zamah's Apparatus
sections.body: Apothecary Zamah works beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff as an ambassador and researcher for the Royal Apothecary Society. With Lydon's formula, she makes an aerosol device called the Toxic Fogger. She intends to use it against the Venture Company goblins.

faq.q: What is the purpose of bringing the toxin to Thunder Bluff?
aliases: what does zamah do with toxin
faq.answer: Lydon made the liquid toxin, but it needs a way to spread across a broad area. Zamah can turn the formula into an aerosol device called the Toxic Fogger.

faq.q: Who is the target of this concoction?
faq.answer: The toxin is meant for the Venture Company, a goblin mining syndicate whose operations reach the Stonetalon Mountains and beyond.
Apothecary Zamah is in the Pools of Vision, beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why are Undercity apothecaries working in a Tauren city?
aliases: why are undead in thunder bluff
faq.answer: The Tauren gave the Forsaken asylum and helped them join the Horde, hoping they might find a cure for their affliction. Zamah represents the Royal Apothecary Society, whose work here turns toward pestilence and weapons rather than healing.

faq.q: What happens after turning in the toxin?
aliases: what after return to thunder bluff
faq.answer: After Zamah receives the vial, she makes the Toxic Fogger. She then sends you to use it at a Venture Company facility in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Apothecary Lydon, a Royal Apothecary Society researcher in Tarren Mill, made the poison.

angles.text: As an Undead, you can see how the Royal Apothecary Society links research in Lordaeron with outposts on Kalimdor.

As a Tauren, you know Magatha Grimtotem and the elders welcomed the Forsaken to Thunder Bluff, hoping they would find redemption or healing. The apothecaries beneath Spirit Rise instead make contagious weapons.
As a member of the Horde, you see Forsaken alchemists working together against the Venture Company's destructive operations.
